content: 第四关（后）

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Everything's gone to hell out there.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Everything's gone to hell out there.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Word is Mephisto's used his Arts to whip up some monsters that even attack us. They'll eat Infected same as anyone.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Word is Mephisto's used his Arts to whip up some monsters that even attack us. They'll eat Infected same as anyone.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Hah. It's over. We lost.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Hah. It's over. We lost.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Somebody found one of Mephisto's teams in some basement room in the slums.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Somebody found one of Mephisto's teams in some basement room in the slums.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  They said the corpses were covered in plants, still growing, to the point they were unrecognizable. Any ideas?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: They said the corpses were covered in plants, still growing, to the point they were unrecognizable. Any ideas?
I'm not sure.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  It's so weird. Why is everything so weird?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: It's so weird. Why is everything so weird?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  We took down Chernobog, but we haven't been able to break Lungmen. It must be because Talulah hasn't shown.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: We took down Chernobog, but we haven't been able to break Lungmen. It must be because Talulah hasn't shown.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  We made the right choice by not going with Crownslayer's crew. No one's been able to find them on the comms.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: We made the right choice by not going with Crownslayer's crew. No one's been able to find them on the comms.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  We're the only ones left here. Sigh.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: We're the only ones left here. Sigh.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  What about you, Lungmen's infected?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: What about you, Lungmen's infected?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Sigh. You know, Lungmenite, you might end up better off than us just for not joining Reunion.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Sigh. You know, Lungmenite, you might end up better off than us just for not joining Reunion.

raw: [name="???"]  We won't be better off for not joining.
content: We won't be better off for not joining.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Was it Talulah's speech that inspired you to join?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Was it Talulah's speech that inspired you to join?

raw: [name="???"]  No. Fancy talking doesn't do much for me.
content: No. Fancy talking doesn't do much for me.

raw: [name="???"]  To ask me something like that... I guess you don't care much for Infected identity politics.
content: To ask me something like that... I guess you don't care much for Infected identity politics.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Oh. Sounds like you don't really believe in that stuff.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Oh. Sounds like you don't really believe in that stuff.

raw: [name="???"]  So why do you stay with Reunion?
content: So why do you stay with Reunion?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Because I have nowhere else to go. But if we never came here, would you still be able to live normal lives?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Because I have nowhere else to go. But if we never came here, would you still be able to live normal lives?

raw: [name="???"]  The Infected purge was always coming. Reunion just sped up the timeline.
content: The Infected purge was always coming. Reunion just sped up the timeline.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  You're pretty clear on that.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: You're pretty clear on that.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  And you're right. My hometown was a little place, far from any of the big cities. They weren't too bad to the Infected either.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: And you're right. My hometown was a little place, far from any of the big cities. They weren't too bad to the Infected either.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  The noble family who ran the show had an Infected daughter. They let us live pretty normal lives in the ghetto. Mine work wasn't too hard.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: The noble family who ran the show had an Infected daughter. They let us live pretty normal lives in the ghetto. Mine work wasn't too hard.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  And the uninfected treated us okay. At least they'd trade with us a bit, sometimes even squat by the wall and share a drink.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: And the uninfected treated us okay. At least they'd trade with us a bit, sometimes even squat by the wall and share a drink.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Then, a few years later, the duke lost a battle or something and got taken away. They sent us a new mayor.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Then, a few years later, the duke lost a battle or something and got taken away. They sent us a new mayor.
'The Great Rebellion'?

raw: [name="???"]  Nobles were getting stripped of their titles left and right.
content: Nobles were getting stripped of their titles left and right.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Maybe. I never understood politics. We'd only get whispers every once in a while.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Maybe. I never understood politics. We'd only get whispers every once in a while.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Supposedly there are Infected Messengers out there somewhere, but Ursus never had them. We didn't know anything.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Supposedly there are Infected Messengers out there somewhere, but Ursus never had them. We didn't know anything.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  At first, everyone lived pretty much like they did before. But there was a sense of something heavier in the air. And every day the food stores ran a little lower.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: At first, everyone lived pretty much like they did before. But there was a sense of something heavier in the air. And every day the food stores ran a little lower.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Slowly but surely, things turned bad. When supplies really started to run low, the uninfected began throwing rocks at us. Then we started disappearing.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Slowly but surely, things turned bad. When supplies really started to run low, the uninfected began throwing rocks at us. Then we started disappearing.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  And after a few dozen speeches in the town square, nobody brought up the mayor's embezzlement, or the way he was renovating the town center for himself.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: And after a few dozen speeches in the town square, nobody brought up the mayor's embezzlement, or the way he was renovating the town center for himself.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  I mean, we Infected could see it. The ordinary townsfolk had to know.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: I mean, we Infected could see it. The ordinary townsfolk had to know.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  From the other side of the ghetto wall, we could hear them chanting things like 'purify the town' and 'exterminate the Infected.'
speaker: Reunion Member
content: From the other side of the ghetto wall, we could hear them chanting things like 'purify the town' and 'exterminate the Infected.'
You were his scapegoat.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  When life gives you lemons, right? But weren't we always scapegoats? I know I said the town treated us pretty well, but that's just for the last few decades.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: When life gives you lemons, right? But weren't we always scapegoats? I know I said the town treated us pretty well, but that's just for the last few decades.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  The rest of the story is pretty simple. They came in and killed most of the Infected. The rest of us fled into the wilderness, where about half of us starved to death.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: The rest of the story is pretty simple. They came in and killed most of the Infected. The rest of us fled into the wilderness, where about half of us starved to death.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Now here in Lungmen, more of us died. Everyone from my hometown is already dead.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Now here in Lungmen, more of us died. Everyone from my hometown is already dead.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  So yeah, you're right. This is the way it goes. There's no place in this world for the Infected. The only cause for hope is that we didn't see it go down ourselves.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: So yeah, you're right. This is the way it goes. There's no place in this world for the Infected. The only cause for hope is that we didn't see it go down ourselves.

raw: [name="???"]  Why are you telling me this?
content: Why are you telling me this?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  I got the feeling I don't have much time left. You don't happen to have a nice, painless way to kill somebody, do you?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: I got the feeling I don't have much time left. You don't happen to have a nice, painless way to kill somebody, do you?
What are you saying...?

speaker: Reunion Member
content: Huh?

speaker: Reunion Member
content: Oh...

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Sorry? I may have misread this.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Sorry? I may have misread this.

raw: [name="???"]  Lungmenites still hate you. You attacked our city.
content: Lungmenites still hate you. You attacked our city.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Sure. But where's the Infected city?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Sure. But where's the Infected city?

speaker: Reunion Member
content: Huh? Fire?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Hey, let's not fly off the handle here... All you had to say was you wanted the window seat. There's no need for violence.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Hey, let's not fly off the handle here... All you had to say was you wanted the window seat. There's no need for violence.

raw: [name="???"]  The fire spreads so quickly. Strange. This is no natural flame.
content: The fire spreads so quickly. Strange. This is no natural flame.

speaker: Reunion Member
content: Why?

raw: [name="???"]  It doesn't spread like a 'true flame.'
content: It doesn't spread like a 'true flame.'

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Then let's get out of here. Who knew this place would go to hell too.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Then let's get out of here. Who knew this place would go to hell too.
And where do we go?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  We'll cross that bridge when we come to it. Come with us. You Lungmenites don't like leaving home, right? Might as well leave it with us.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it. Come with us. You Lungmenites don't like leaving home, right? Might as well leave it with us.
Go with you?

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Sure, why not? You don't have to if you don't want it.
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Sure, why not? You don't have to if you don't want it.
...I'll think about it.
But, home...
Where is home?
